messages:
anya: kicking off a small GPTQ micro-bake to validate onboarding heuristics for Llama2-13B, Mistral-7B-v0.1, and Qwen-7B. primary goals: keep eval delta <2% on HH_eval and long-context QA, validate kv-cache correctness, and gather latency/cost profiles for hosted vs dedicated lanes.

mike: SGTM. which quant variants? gptq4 + awq4? FP8 for spot checks? :thinking_face:

anya: yep — baseline: fp16 (gold), then gptq-4bit (per-channel), awq-int4 (default pack), and one FP8 run for Mistral where supported.

raj: quick note — Qwen variants historically show instruction tuning sensitivity; expect higher deltas on instruction-heavy evals (LLM_InstSuite).

sam: first dry run finished. posting quick numbers (HH_eval accuracy change vs fp16):
- Llama2-13B gptq4: -1.7% | p50 latency +12% on A100-40G | tokens/s ~1.1x fp16
- Llama2-13B awq4: -2.4% | latency -28% on T4 | tokens/s ~1.6x fp16
- Mistral-7B gptq4: -0.9% | kv-cache mismatch on >8k context (see sample)
- Qwen-7B gptq4: -3.8% | mathbench drop 4.1% (mapping issues)

claire: can you paste the command so I can repro locally?

sam: sure:
```
./bake.sh --models "llama2-13b,mistral-7b-v0.1,qwen-7b" --quants "gptq4,awq4,fp8" --evals "hh_eval,longqa,mathbench,kv_regression" --hw "a100-40g,t4" --outdir /tmp/bake_230123
```

anya: thanks. about the Mistral kv issue — sample log shows KV keys truncating after 12k tokens during decoding on gptq build. attaching snippet: "decoded_seq truncated at chunk boundary -> mismatch with fp16". That explains the long-context QA regression.

raj: likely kernel alignment problem with our paste_offset optimization; I saw a similar bug in AWQ bringup last quarter. can you dump the kv hex for one failure?

sam: posted hex to the private S3 link (redacted) and added to the eval run metadata.

eval-bot: automated regression check: Llama2-13B awq4 mathbench delta = -2.9% (FAIL threshold 2%). flagged test-case ids: MATH-034, MATH-078.

anya: ok flagged. decision notes:
- Llama2-13B: prefer GPTQ4 for Dedicated (better quality, acceptable perf). AWQ4 for Hosted low-cost offering but keep strict eval gating.
- Mistral-7B: block GPTQ4 for long-context routes until kv fix; AWQ4 and FP8 acceptable for short-context.
- Qwen-7B: hold for more root-cause on math regressions; might need family-specific decoding map.

mike: ops/deploy note — we should create two model variants in catalog: "llama2-13b-gptq4-stable" and "llama2-13b-awq4-lowcost" with metadata fields indicating expected accuracy delta, recommended lanes, and pinned kernel version.

claire: adding checklist items for release playbook:
1) add unit regression (kv integrity) to nightly for Mistral
2) add mathbench gating for Qwen family
3) instrument per-token mismatch detector in runtime logs
4) update cost estimates in catalog

sam: rough perf/cost numbers from run (per-1k tokens, normalized):
- llama2-13b fp16: $1.00 cost, baseline p95 latency 220ms
- llama2-13b gptq4: $0.58 cost, p95 latency 245ms
- llama2-13b awq4: $0.41 cost, p95 latency 160ms
These are cluster-level back-of-envelope numbers.

anya: we need a short blurb for product saying where to route: Dedicated -> gptq4; Hosted bursts / low-cost -> awq4 with canary and auto-fallback to fp16. keep it simple.

raj: follow-up experiments requested:
- rerun Mistral gptq4 with paste_offset disabled
- run Qwen gptq4 with alt tokenization map from qwen-team
- include safety/toxicity quick-checks for awq4 variants

claire: i'll own the canary + rollout policy update in the console (add explicit fallback to fp16 on >1% regression).

anya: timeline: aim to close blockers and rerun primary gating evals by EOD +2 days. will update thread with final verdict. thanks all. :v:
